title: Reproduction Bundle for “Diverging paths to dark-matter discovery”
description: Reproduction bundle for Diverging paths to dark-matter discovery, version 3.1.0. Adds a shared script/notebook route, exact frozen inputs with lossless restoration, conditional reconstruction of 57 network graph/window combinations, approved stepwise main-figure presentation, and bundled STIX typography. Corpus, candidate products, bootstrap/sensitivity outputs and historical network archives retain their v3.0.0 scientific identities. The analysis cutoff is 2025. No new retrieval, classification validation, annotation or bootstrap resampling is claimed. Current raw-abstract extraction is not asserted to recreate historical network event tables. Manuscript text and the preprint remain separate.
notes: New execution, presentation and package-naming version. Scientific baseline: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23263996. Preserve the existing Zenodo version lineage. A fresh GitHub mirror named diverging-paths can be created from the published package.
